description: Project-level references for magazine covers, editorial spreads, long-form visual essays, and publication systems.

entries.why: A useful editorial reference for turning long-form content into a paced visual system with covers, feature openers, captions, pull quotes, and image sequencing.

compositions.title: Headline-first cover stack
compositions.study: The cover opener gives the story one dominant editorial promise before supporting metadata appears.
compositions.reuse: Use for reports, magazines, launch essays, and narrative portfolios.

compositions.title: Alternating dense and quiet spreads
compositions.study: Reading pace comes from alternating text-heavy passages with image-led pauses.
compositions.reuse: Use when long content needs more rhythm than a standard article template.

assets.notes: Pull quotes break long passages and create scanning anchors.
assets.reuse: Use only when the quote advances the argument, not as decoration.

assets.notes: Captions should be legible but subordinate to body copy.
assets.reuse: Use consistent caption tone and placement across a feature.

implementation.notes: Useful for publication pages, PDF-like reports, and editorial landing pages.

entries.why: A useful counterpoint to clean editorial grids: the spreads use collage, photocopy texture, fake adverts, abrupt pacing, and calm interludes to keep a raw magazine rhythm readable.

compositions.title: Anti-grid with controlled pacing
compositions.study: The issue breaks conventional grids but still alternates loud openings, disruptive inserts, and quieter interview pages.
compositions.reuse: Use when an editorial piece needs punk energy without losing reading order.

compositions.title: Collage as context, not filler
compositions.study: Layered objects, sampled visual references, and tape-like texture make each spread feel found and authored at once.
compositions.reuse: Use collaged fragments to create viewpoint and pace, not just to decorate empty space.

assets.notes: Found-feeling imagery creates tactile atmosphere but must be licensed or recreated originally.
assets.reuse: Make original scans, textures, marks, and crops instead of copying magazine artwork.

assets.notes: Oversized type can function as a disruptive object between image-led sections.
assets.reuse: Use type scale breaks intentionally to reset attention across a long feature.

implementation.notes: Useful for zines, culture reports, event books, and expressive editorial landing pages.

project.title: The Pudding: Colorism in High Fashion

entries.why: A strong digital editorial reference for making methodology, evidence, and narrative feel like one reading experience through sequenced visuals, clear authorship, and paced explanation.

compositions.title: Editorial claim before method
compositions.study: The opener establishes the cultural question before the article introduces calculation and methodology.
compositions.reuse: Use when a data story needs an emotional reading path before technical evidence appears.

compositions.title: Method as visual narrative
compositions.study: Process steps are explained with visuals so readers understand how the evidence is constructed.
compositions.reuse: Show the method in small visual increments instead of hiding it in a footnote.

assets.notes: Captions and annotations carry trust by explaining what each visual means.
assets.reuse: Pair every quantitative visual with a concise explanation of source, measure, or limitation.

assets.notes: Images are part of the evidence, not generic editorial decoration.
assets.reuse: Use licensed or original visual datasets and keep source boundaries explicit.

motion.title: Scrollytelling evidence reveal
motion.notes: Long-form progression can reveal argument, process, and result in sequence.
motion.fallback: A static stacked layout should preserve the same evidence order.

interactions.title: Reader-controlled proof path
interactions.study: The article supports deeper reading through methods and linked evidence.
interactions.reuse: Offer method/detail exits without interrupting the main narrative.

implementation.notes: Useful for data essays, annual reports, research explainers, and investigative product stories.
